boats.name: Sunseeker 42
boats.description: A sleek motor yacht built for day cruising and sunset parties. Twin diesels, a spacious cockpit, and a foredeck sun pad for up to eight guests.

boats.name: Catalina 30 Sailboat
boats.description: A forgiving, well-balanced cruiser perfect for a relaxed sail around the bay. Bareboat-friendly for sailors with experience; skipper available on request.

boats.name: Boston Whaler 230
boats.description: Unsinkable, nimble, and great for fishing or island-hopping. Shallow draft lets you nose right up to the sandbar.

boats.name: Azimut 55 Flybridge
boats.description: Flagship luxury for special occasions. Crewed flybridge yacht with three staterooms, a top-deck lounge, and room for a dozen guests in comfort.

boats.name: Bennington 24 Pontoon
boats.description: A floating living room for the whole crew. Easy to drive, stable as a dock, and ideal for a lazy day on the lake with tubing and swimming.

boats.name: Sea Ray 190 Bowrider
boats.description: Punchy, fun bowrider for watersports and cruising. Pulls a wakeboarder all day and seats six for the ride back to the dock.
